stem:
There are several energy transformations that occur when a person flips a light switch and a lamp turns on.
Students are asked to formulate a hypothesis about these energy conversions.

Which student hypothesis is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Mechanical energy in the hand converts into chemical energy in the body and then is converted to light energy in the bulb.

options.label: B
options.text: Mechanical energy in the hand converts into light energy in the bulb and is then converted to chemical energy.

options.label: C
options.text: Chemical energy in the body converts into light energy in the bulb and then is converted to electrical energy.

options.label: D
options.text: Chemical energy in the body converts into mechanical energy in the hand and electrical energy in the bulb is converted to light energy.
